name: 03229 · Hopkinton, NH
findings: ZIP 03229 (Hopkinton) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03229 (Hopkinton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 03229 (Hopkinton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
